# Blender Mentor
**Turn Claude Code / DSH / Cursor into a senior Blender mentor + technical director.**
It diagnoses your level, teaches a structured lesson, grades your work with a 0–3 rubric, and runs m
achine acceptance on your `.blend` — assets, curves, renders, ESD secondary animation, and biomechan
ne acceptance on your `.blend` — assets, curves, renders, ESD secondary animation, and biomechanics.

> **Not a Blender add-on.** The skill gives your AI agent the mentor's playbook. It can generate com
mands and, when the host has shell/Blender access (or an MCP bridge), run `blender -b ... --python .

## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

1. `SKILL.md` routes the request and sets the delivery loop.
2. `preflight.py` classifies it: `proce
ed` (module-backed), `proceed_core` (teaching/operations, no module needed), `ask`, or `block` (refe

rence data required but not covered).
3. `load_router.py` builds a per-task load plan and only loads

modules selected by preflight; `proceed_core` tasks get core docs, never modules.
4. `source_audit.
py` checks standards/books/papers before module-backed delivery: TTL, withdrawn/superseded, and miss

ing jurisdiction block.
5. Acceptance scripts run against your local `.blend` through headless Blend

er.
6. Your files stay local; the acceptance tools do not upload anything.

## FAQ

**Is this a Blender add-on?**
No. It is an Agent Skill: instructions + scripts that an AI client loa
ds. Blender itself is a separate install.

**Do I need Blender installed?**
For teaching, critique, and planning: no. For opening `.blend` file
s, rendering probes, and machine acceptance: yes, Blender 4.2 LTS / 5.x.

**Does it control the Blender GUI?**
No. It writes and runs bpy/headless scripts and reviews the art
ifacts you provide; it does not click through the interface.

**Is my `.blend` uploaded?**
No. Acceptance scripts run locally and print JSON/text; they do not upl
